_doc: Lanternroot's cast as sprite sheets (pipeline/animation/README.md, ADR-0063). Each character's look comes from the game's content (townsfolk.jsonc; the player's is looks.jsonc `start`); this file holds how they are made: the camera every turn shares, the views, the sheet's layout and sizes, the ComfyUI restyle, the prompt words for every part, the fixed colours (boots, wood, glow...), and one short description per character from their portrait.

prompt.body: full body sprite of {who}, {parts}, {boots}, standing still, arms slightly away from the body, feet apart, {view}
prompt.suffix: , single rpg character sprite, plain white background, clean dark outline, crisp pixels, limited palette, simple cel shading, centered, whole figure visible from head to feet
prompt.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, text, watermark, signature, sprite sheet, multiple characters, collage, grid, tileset, background, scenery, cropped, frame, border, drop shadow, gradient background, realistic, photo, 3d render, extra limbs, deformed hands, floating object, sparkles, stars, particles, weapon, sword, shield, nsfw

view_negative.front: back view, side view, profile, three-quarter view
view_negative.left: front view, three-quarter view, both eyes, back view
view_negative.back: face, eyes, nose, mouth, front view, three-quarter view
view_negative.right: front view, three-quarter view, both eyes, back view

parts.outfit/undersuit: a plain fitted {second} shirt and shorts
parts.outfit/tunic: {main} tunic with {second} trim and a {accent} sash
parts.hat/visor: full {metal} helmet with a glowing visor
parts.item/book: holding a thick teal book against the hip
parts.item/staff: gripping a tall pale wooden staff in one hand

pip.who: a cheerful young boy with freckles

quartermaster.who: a jolly old man with a white moustache

sergeant.who: a silver-haired officer with swept short hair and steel plate armor
